title: Screw a canning band onto a filled pint Mason jar over its loose flat lid, started square, turned fingertip-tight
instruction: Screw the band on over the lid, fingertip-tight, ready for the canner.
context: Closing a two-piece canning lid is the step home-canning guides (NDSU Extension, Clemson HGIC) spell out: lid centred, band fingertip-tight, so air can vent and the jar seals. The band is a 74 mm ring that must start square on a continuous glass thread over a loose 6 g disc and be turned about one and a quarter turns, regripping every 150 degrees or so; started tilted, it cross-threads and cocks or knocks off the lid.
setup: Units cm, kg; x forward from the arm bases, y left; origins on the counter (74.75 cm up). Task objects: Ball regular-mouth pint jar, glass, 7.94 dia x 12.7 to the rim, thread 6.99 dia (6 per inch, 1.25 turns), filled with jam to 1.3 cm headspace, 0.75, at (30, -4). Flat lid: tinplate disc 6.72 dia x 0.15 with sealing compound, 0.006, resting on the rim within 0.04 of centred. Screw band: tinplate ring 7.36 outside dia x 1.35 tall, flange opening 5.8, 0.011, standing flange up on the counter at (22, -21). Distractors, ignored by scoring (SimReady): two cucumbers 5.2x17x4.8, 0.15 each, at (52, 7) yaw 1.45 rad and (53, -3) yaw 1.75 rad; ceramic mixing bowl 16.3 dia x 5.5, 0.35, at (50, 25); cotton dish cloth 26x23.3x2.1, 0.05, at (47, -25) yaw 0.3 rad.
scoring: 0 if the jar ever tips more than 25 degrees or the disc ever leaves the rim (centre over 12 mm off the jar's axis, or underside over 5 mm below the rim). Band rise = its top's height above its seated height (on the disc on the rim). 1.0: rise at most 1.0 mm, band within 2 degrees of the jar's axis and centred within 2 mm, disc flat within 2 degrees and centred within 2.5 mm, jar within 5 degrees of upright and within 3 mm of the counter, nothing moving, every fingertip at least 3 cm from jar and band, all held 1 s. 0.5: band within 2 degrees and 2 mm of centred, rise at most 2.0 mm, disc within 5 degrees of flat. 0.25: band within 4 degrees and 3 mm of centred, rise at most 2.5 mm (threaded on; an unthreaded band rests at least 3.7 mm up). 0 otherwise.
reset_notes: Unscrew and stand the band back on its tape mark; recentre the same disc on the rim. A disc that fell off is replaced with a new one. No heat: the jar is filled cold for trials.
fidelity: Jar, disc and band are custom rigid meshes at the Ball pint's published size (SimReady has no canning jar). The glass thread and band thread are real helical contact geometry (convex segments), 6 per inch; turn count and thread section are estimates. No tightening torque or force sensing: fingertip-tight versus cranked down is not distinguished, and the compound has no give. Glass-on-counter friction 0.5. Distractors are SimReady props.
